name: Admin Back Office
description: Polished React back office for Cloudgate with native user management, analytics, branding and themes, SMTP, media, logs, About and Wallet readiness. Includes light/dark modes, responsive layouts and smooth transitions, plus Dashboard and Orders placeholders for your own features.

workflowImport.description: Creates an empty Admin controller for native API app scoping. No sample workflows, databases or records are included.
workflowImport.publishHint: Import the empty controller bundle or use your existing controller, then sign in with a tenant IdP Admin account. No workflow publication or app database is required. The server must include the native payments status API and the appearance API with its platform migration.

features: Dashboard and Orders placeholders for app-specific features
Website analytics and scoped workflow logs
